nodes.name: Loose Ends
nodes.author: Jeremy Longshore
nodes.description: Loose Ends turns unfinished local Git work into a quiet local Omarchy bar queue. Every five minutes it scans repositories under home for uncommitted edits, unpushed commits, old stashes, detached heads, and interrupted rebases, merges, cherry-picks, or bisects. It surfaces interrupted work urgently, otherwise oldest first. It makes no network calls and does not modify repositories. Discovery and Git reads are time and size bounded; if a cap is reached, the panel clearly says the scan is partial.

nodes.name: Capture Conveyor
nodes.author: Jeremy Longshore
nodes.description: Capture Conveyor turns Omarchy screenshots into a keyboard-first inbox, not a forgotten folder. The bar counts captures; open the panel for the newest 24, select with arrow keys, start a screenshot or OCR region, copy its path, or reveal its folder. It refreshes every 20 seconds. Its bounded scanner reads only top-level screenshot PNG names, paths, sizes, and timestamps. It never reads image pixels, OCRs existing files, watches your clipboard, uploads data, opens an account, or uses the network.

nodes.name: Workspace Storyboard
nodes.author: Jeremy Longshore
nodes.description: Workspace Storyboard turns your Omarchy bar into a local map of live Hyprland workspaces. See workspace window counts and the active window title, then click or use Up/Down, Enter, or 1-9 to jump back into context. It retains a clearable, capped re-entry trail of workspace IDs, titles, application classes, and timestamps in private local state. It makes no network requests, and its Hyprland reads and panel payload are time and byte bounded. It stores 40 events and shows the newest eight locally.

nodes.name: Quiet Queue
nodes.author: Jeremy Longshore
nodes.description: Quiet Queue adds a trustworthy focus switch to Omarchy. Start a 25- or 50-minute session, see the countdown in the bar, and return to normal notification delivery when it expires. It uses Omarchy's native Do Not Disturb service: silenced notifications stay in first-party history, and Quiet Queue never reads, uploads, replaces, or discards them. It turns DND off only when it owns the session; existing DND is left alone, and an external change revokes stale ownership. State checks every 5 seconds.

nodes.description: Full-text file search overlay for the localsearch index. Bind a key to open it, or click the bar widget.

nodes.name: USB Doctor
nodes.author: tngyema
nodes.description: Diagnose USB flash drives that cannot be read or written. Simple health view for normal users, detailed evidence for advanced users.

nodes.name: OmaCalendar
nodes.author: OmaCalendar contributors
nodes.description: Requires the separately installed OmaCalendar app. Adds calendar, agenda, and Up Next controls backed by its local daemon.

nodes.name: QuickMap
nodes.author: Colin Faulkingham
nodes.description: Look up an address or get driving and walking directions from OpenStreetMap.

nodes.name: Oma Aux
nodes.author: sam0110
nodes.description: A PipeWire patchbay for connecting applications, devices, monitors, and filters from the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Samsung TV Remote
nodes.author: Ryan Doupe
nodes.description: Samsung TV remote in the bar. Arrow keys, enter and backspace to navigate. Keys 1-9 launch the apps your TV has: YouTube, Netflix, Prime Video. Hold a key to repeat like the real remote. Volume with live readout. Wake-on-LAN turns the TV on and reopens what you were watching. Finds your TV itself, no IP to enter. Bindable to a hotkey. Samsung Tizen 2016+. Python 3 only.

nodes.name: Spanned Background
nodes.author: Marc Ferro
nodes.description: Draws one wallpaper stretched across every connected monitor, Windows 'Span' style. Drop-in replacement for the built-in omarchy.background service.

nodes.name: Arcana
nodes.author: Ministry of Taste
nodes.description: A keyboard-first, shell-native reflective tarot system for Omarchy Quattro.

nodes.name: Omari
nodes.author: bergdahlchi
nodes.description: You like the Niri wayland compositor but don't want to leave the cool world of Omarchy. Omari adds Niri-inspired scrolling, gestures, Workspace overview and Alt-Tab switcher of course styled with your Omarchy theme.

nodes.name: Screensaver
nodes.author: Brian
nodes.description: Screensaver settings: toggle, idle timing, effect picker, branding

nodes.name: Green Room
nodes.author: João Pereira
nodes.description: One-click mirrored webcam and mic check from the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Binaural
nodes.author: Callum Lees
nodes.description: A minimal binaural beat suite, including options for brown noise or rain sounds with independent level controls

nodes.name: Lava Lamp
nodes.author: Bacon
nodes.description: Live lava lamp background — real convection physics, merging wax, pointer play and a live control panel

nodes.name: Agent Wool
nodes.author: Parker Brown
nodes.description: The whole flock on one wall — every coding agent's face, state and vitals, fed by the herd state bus

nodes.name: TrueNAS Apps Watcher
nodes.author: David Boulay
nodes.description: Watches a TrueNAS SCALE server for pending app upgrades and newer container images — and, through Portainer, for updates to the containers TrueNAS doesn't manage — and applies them from the bar.

nodes.name: Omachords
nodes.author: Kyle
nodes.description: Build and compare triads and seventh chords across tonal and chromatic pitch circles.

nodes.name: OpenProject Tasks
nodes.author: helderrscorreia
nodes.description: Open assigned OpenProject work packages with priorities, time tracking (start/stop timer), and comment labels.

nodes.name: Browser Switcher
nodes.author: Sven Strothoff
nodes.description: Switch which browser or isolated browser profile opened links go to, straight from the bar.

nodes.name: Local AI
nodes.author: 0xSero
nodes.description: Run the model validated for your GPU as one button on the bar. Start downloads it, proves it works, and serves it; Open agent starts any coding agent on it (claude, codex, pi, opencode, crush, and more) with nothing written to your config; Share puts the same keyed endpoint on your tailnet in one click. Every detected GPU is listed and any can be picked. 34 validated recipes for NVIDIA and Intel Arc, two Docker containers only this plugin touches, and every refusal spelled out on the card.

nodes.name: Omadates
nodes.author: Gabbe2312
nodes.description: Apple Calendar in your Omarchy bar. Dots on the days that have something, today's events under the month grid, and a click for the details. Syncs iCloud, any CalDAV server, and webcal subscriptions.

nodes.name: Omalet
nodes.author: Ravi Vasavan
nodes.description: Owlet Smart Sock 3 vitals on the Omarchy bar: heart rate, blood oxygen, battery, skin temperature, movement, sleep, and desktop alerts. Unofficial Owlet cloud API; not a substitute for the Owlet app.

nodes.name: Tokscale
nodes.author: jwty
nodes.description: Tokscale token usage and spend widget for the Omarchy status bar.

nodes.name: Scratchpad Deck
nodes.author: TierTek
nodes.description: A visual scratchpad switcher for the Omarchy bar. Shows live previews of the windows hiding in your scratchpads and gives each one its own hotkey.

nodes.name: Hebrew Calendar & Zmanim
nodes.author: vbtwo
nodes.description: Date label with a calendar popup that pairs every Gregorian day with its Hebrew date, marks days that carry a holiday or a note, and shows holiday info, candle-lighting and Shabbat/holiday-end times for the day you click.

nodes.name: Seismic Atlas
nodes.author: Pieter Geutjens
nodes.description: Track earthquakes, volcanoes, tsunami bulletins, plate boundaries, and monitoring stations on a rotatable globe.

nodes.name: Audio Resolver
nodes.author: TechWhispers
nodes.description: Prepare camera footage for DaVinci Resolve on Linux by converting AAC audio to PCM in Resolve-ready .mov files without re-encoding video.

nodes.name: Dopewars
nodes.author: Ninepoint Labs
nodes.description: The classic dopewars (Drug Wars) turn-based trading game, the whole single-player game living in a bar panel. Your game is saved after every move, so take a turn whenever you feel like it.

nodes.name: OmaResume
nodes.author: jimg4
nodes.description: Save a window inventory and recover supported applications after login.

nodes.name: ThreatSpire CTI
nodes.author: jfaulhefer
nodes.description: Live CTI metrics from a ThreatSpire tenant in the Omarchy bar: honeypot observations, adversary IPs, IOCs, credential attempts, and campaign activity. Authenticates with a ThreatSpire API key generated on your profile page.

nodes.name: Wireless Display Cast
nodes.author: shady
nodes.description: Open the Miracast receiver picker and check wireless display prerequisites using GNOME Network Displays.

nodes.name: Wi-Fi Privacy
nodes.author: Loupi
nodes.description: MAC address randomization, DHCP hostname cloaking, and Wi-Fi tracking protection for Omarchy.

nodes.name: Omaclippr
nodes.author: dooooooks
nodes.description: Background instant replay buffer to capture your best gaming moments and desktop highlights on demand.

nodes.name: Display and Color Controls
nodes.author: tdownie0
nodes.description: Display brightness, scale and laptop controls, plus advanced color controls (brightness, temperature, gamma, inversion) via wl-gammarelay.

nodes.name: Omableep
nodes.author: Jankees van Woezik
nodes.description: Retro soundboard: chip sounds synthesised on the spot, machine sounds from real recordings.

nodes.name: Folder Shelf
nodes.author: samara-hub-ro
nodes.description: A glass shelf on your desktop holding the folders you actually use: hover one to see inside it — thumbnails, recent files, size, composition and permissions — and open it in your file manager with a double click.

nodes.name: BibleTales
nodes.author: Shirak Semonian
nodes.description: One Bible story a day, told as literature. A calm bar widget that opens a beautifully typeset reading pane: every day brings one installment of a classic story (3-4 short chapters to page through) written in modern literary English with no preaching and no church jargon — just drama, imagery and a quiet cliffhanger that makes you look forward to tomorrow. Deterministic day rotation, fully offline reading; an optional read-aloud button speaks the day-part through Edge TTS (no key, no tracking).

nodes.name: OmaIce
nodes.author: TerrifiedBug
nodes.description: Ice-style hidden section for the bar: everything left of the chevron hides, plus the system tray.

nodes.name: Remminarchy
nodes.author: Sorena100
nodes.description: Remmina remote desktop profiles and active sessions in the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Barkeep
nodes.author: Nine Point Labs
nodes.description: Keyboard-driven overlay that tends your Omarchy bar: see every installed shell plugin, switch it on or off, slide it along the bar, pin it to the center, pull updates and remove what you no longer pour.

nodes.name: AI Hub
nodes.author: Johan Lopez
nodes.description: Ollama service control, coding-agent usage, launch shortcut, default-agent switching, and custom agent harnesses in one Omarchy bar panel.

nodes.name: hypr-dwm-land
nodes.author: Person1873
nodes.description: DWM-style tags for Hyprland (Lua module + bar widget)

nodes.name: Pigeon
nodes.author: xyzlab
nodes.description: ntfy inbox in the bar. Streams messages from ntfy.sh or your own server into a themed panel with topic tabs, search, toasts, unread badge, click and http actions, attachments, and a compose box. Token or basic auth.

nodes.name: Pixel Shift
nodes.author: Arseniy Zarechnev
nodes.description: OLED burn-in protection for the bar: walks its edge padding and center a few pixels back and forth, too slowly to notice

nodes.name: Zorkmachy
nodes.author: Ninepoint Labs
nodes.description: Zork I, II and III in a bar panel. The original Infocom games (MIT-licensed by Microsoft) run on the frotz Z-machine interpreter; every move is saved, so you can pick up the adventure whenever you like.

nodes.name: Football Tracker
nodes.author: bekkenes
nodes.description: Tracks your favorite football teams: match-day and kickoff notifications, live goal/card/substitution alerts, and a bar widget with upcoming fixtures.

nodes.name: Praefectus OpenCode
nodes.author: jcergolj
nodes.description: Live OpenCode agent counts and session switching in the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Speech to Text
nodes.author: alanfortlink
nodes.description: Dictation with a live waveform and live text in the bar, a browsable history of every recording and its transcript, and configurable keys per language (toggle, and toggle + Return). Uses the same local Whisper engine Omarchy ships (voxtype) by default; other engines are configurable.

nodes.name: Stargazer
nodes.author: chrhicks
nodes.description: Hourly observing weather, Moon position and astronomical darkness in your Omarchy theme.

nodes.name: OmCursor Forge
nodes.author: Erik Burdett
nodes.description: Forge retro pixel-art mouse cursors from the bar — theme-matched colors, a lich's skeletal hand, a sword, a wand, or your own image.

nodes.name: Tally
nodes.author: Ruben Assink
nodes.description: Your payments in the Omarchy bar: balance, payouts, recent payments, and a notification when you get paid, refunded, disputed, or paid out. Stripe today, more providers to come.

nodes.name: OmaSpaces
nodes.author: TerrifiedBug
nodes.description: Mission-Control-style overview: workspaces across, grouped tabs down, live thumbnails, opened by a three-finger swipe up.

nodes.name: Update Center
nodes.author: Saiiiiiph
nodes.description: One quiet indicator for pending system, AUR, Flatpak, and Omarchy plugin updates.

nodes.name: RSS news
nodes.author: Marius Ghizdavet
nodes.description: An RSS reader in the Omarchy bar: the unread count, the items in a panel, mark-all-read, and feed management. Speaks 10 languages, following the system locale by default.

nodes.name: Rain Radar Belgium & Netherlands
nodes.author: dzanaga
nodes.description: Buienradar rain forecast for Belgium and the Netherlands

nodes.name: Keypad
nodes.author: mfilm
nodes.description: Turn a cheap USB macropad into a programmable control surface. Draws your pad, and clicking a key or a knob assigns it a command. Layers are done in software, because these pads report the same keycodes on every hardware layer and say nothing when their layer button is pressed.

nodes.name: NewsFlash
nodes.author: Shirak Semonian
nodes.description: Daily world news in a minimalist bar widget. One-time IP geolocation opens the edition of the country you are in (190+ countries; localized sections, English search feed elsewhere). Lead story with optional image over a compact list with LIVE markers and relative times. Click a headline to read the full article inside the panel (local extraction). Read-aloud in the edition's own language (edge-tts). Quiet polling (5-60 min) via Google News RSS with BBC/Guardian fallback. No key, no tracking.

nodes.name: Spectra
nodes.author: Kevin Cardwell
nodes.description: Audio spectrum for the Omarchy bar. Ten styles from bars and beads to spikes, steps and filled curves; one shared cava capture across every monitor that suspends itself when nothing is playing.

nodes.name: PICO-8 Widget
nodes.author: Guy Kroizman
nodes.description: A daily PICO-8 game in the bar: cover, description and a link to play it on lexaloffle.com. Bookmark games you want to come back to.

nodes.name: Hidden Wi-Fi
nodes.author: dimef; based on Omarchy
nodes.description: Omarchy network panel with an inline form for connecting to hidden Wi-Fi networks.

nodes.name: Grace Window
nodes.author: CoolJam
nodes.description: Reopen recently closed window, including its content with SUPER+SHIFT+W. The plugin rebinds SUPER+W to move the focused window silently to workspace 10 with a one-minute reopen grace period until it gets closed for real. You can configure the keybindings, hidden window look, grace period, … (see README for more)! Disabling or uninstalling the plugin via omarchy's plugin system removes its managed block from "~/.config/hypr/bindings.lua" automatically to restore your previous keybindings.

nodes.name: Advanced Displays
nodes.author: Fredrik Öhrström
nodes.description: Per-display resolution, arrangement, refresh rate, scale, rotation, mirroring, VRR, HDR, brightness and arrangement, with safe apply and persistence to monitors.lua

nodes.name: Grammarchy
nodes.author: kszx11
nodes.description: A local-first English grammar map and learning widget for the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Wyoming Read Aloud
nodes.author: chalkers
nodes.description: Read selected text through a configurable Wyoming TTS server, with buffered sentence playback and native player controls.

nodes.name: OmaThock
nodes.author: TerrifiedBug
nodes.description: Mechanical keyboard sounds on every keypress. No input group, no daemon: Hyprland's Lua event bus feeds QtMultimedia inside the shell. Plays thock soundpacks.

nodes.name: Rock Arch
nodes.author: ONE&ALL
nodes.description: Bridging Rock RMS and Omarchy

nodes.name: OClocky
nodes.author: kingnick
nodes.description: LED alarm-clock bar widget plus analog desktop clock, calendar, media, and quote cards on empty monitors.

nodes.name: Git Radar
nodes.author: Ozan Özdil
nodes.description: Developer pulse, live commit activity and multi-repo tracker for Omarchy Linux

nodes.name: Hyprpin
nodes.author: Jon Kinney
nodes.description: Keeps chosen windows visible when you switch away from their workspace: moved onto a display of their own, parked in a corner, or tucked into the scratchpad. Compositor-level picture-in-picture for video calls.

nodes.name: Hotkey HUD
nodes.author: Dagyr
nodes.description: Floating keystroke HUD overlay and status bar indicator for pressed hotkeys and window manager shortcuts.

nodes.name: Bananet
nodes.author: banan
nodes.description: Bananet — where does your traffic go? Networks, tunnels, egress route and per-service connections in the Omarchy bar: Wi-Fi, Ethernet, Tailscale, ZeroTier, WireGuard / MikroTik Back To Home, OpenVPN, public IP and its owner, live throughput with 24 h charts, routes, DNS, which services talk to which addresses over which link, and alerts when the egress link, the public IP or the listening services change.

nodes.name: Yandex Music
nodes.author: vornashev
nodes.description: Native Yandex Music player with catalog, owned-playlist management, library, queue and MPRIS

nodes.name: OChessy
nodes.author: kingnick
nodes.description: Chess.com stats on the bar, local Stockfish game review, and allowlisted lesson links.

nodes.name: Omostrich
nodes.author: tim
nodes.description: Local Nostr signer and note composer for Omarchy. One bar chip to unlock your locally encrypted Nostr key, compose and post kind-1 notes, approve NIP-46 signing requests from other Nostr apps, and manage relays and authorized apps. Plus a compose-only hotkey overlay (SUPER + N). Not a feed or client; your private key never leaves the local vault.

nodes.name: Dashboard DL
nodes.author: TheFlngDutchman
nodes.description: Clock with calendar, media, system and weather dashboard, plus a yt-dlp download button for whatever is playing

nodes.name: Fat Cat Pomodoro
nodes.author: jeremielumandong
nodes.description: A cozy cat sanctuary for your Pomodoro breaks, with persistent timers, personalities, and a growing collection.

nodes.name: Clipboard History
nodes.author: alanfortlink
nodes.description: Raycast-style clipboard history: fuzzy search over content, type, app and date, with rich per-type previews

nodes.name: Omakanvas
nodes.author: Erik Bourget
nodes.description: Canvas bar widget supporting multiple login methods, persisting your course information so you can ask your agents about it, and more.

nodes.name: omaTrail
nodes.author: Jeremy Longshore
nodes.description: omaTrail launches frontier survival from the Omarchy bar. Name your party, pack a wagon, set pace/rations, cross rivers, face illness, trade, and hunt wildlife. Choose original omaTrail rules or an independently built Classic 1978-inspired profile. Play either in Green Monitor or Color Deluxe graphics by keyboard or mouse. Offline only: no network, telemetry, account, daemon, or elevated access. Saves keep a backup. Design: https://gist.github.com/jeremylongshore/f6bfa2df134361ec33faa552a6df56d1

nodes.name: Omasnake
nodes.author: Faeric
nodes.description: A theme-aware monochrome Snake game for the Omarchy bar, inspired by classic mobile phones.

nodes.name: Chromatic Tuner
nodes.author: bronder
nodes.description: Chromatic instrument tuner with large note display, flat-to-sharp pitch meter, configurable in-tune tolerance, reference pitch, instrument presets, and an inline grouped source list for microphones, USB/built-in devices, and multichannel audio interfaces.

nodes.name: Tablet Toggle
nodes.author: ngek202
nodes.description: Tablet-mode toggle bar-widget for convertible laptops. Left-click toggles tablet mode; right-click runs an interactive health check (repair only if problems are found). If the companion package is missing, either click installs it visibly (pinned, idempotent). After install: SUPER+B = on-screen keyboard (SAM OSK) · SUPER+SHIFT+T = tablet mode · 3-finger swipes = pages and tablet exit. Companion to the tablet-kbd package.

nodes.name: DualSense
nodes.author: Atos Lins
nodes.description: PlayStation DualSense battery, lightbar, player LEDs, adaptive triggers, audio, rumble and a live input tester in the bar

nodes.name: DictDrawer
nodes.author: mbelli
nodes.description: A sliding Voxtype and Handy history drawer with persistent local transcripts, full-history search, and one-click copy

nodes.name: Remote servers
nodes.author: Majkelll
nodes.description: Keep a list of your own SSH servers in the bar: open a console, watch live load/RAM/uptime, and get told when one drops or comes back. One button sets up key-based auth, so no password is ever stored or asked for again.

nodes.name: FileBlade Agent Memory
nodes.author: Kurt Buhler
nodes.description: Browse the instructions, rules, and durable auto-memory that coding agents load, and link a file to more agents, in the FileBlade blades.

nodes.name: Remote Desktop
nodes.author: Kostadin Kadiev
nodes.description: Share your existing Omarchy desktop over RDP with simple setup, private-network binding and native shell controls.

nodes.name: Aura Blur
nodes.author: Yeshuah Franco
nodes.description: Adds a continuous, high-quality radial blur around Omarchy popups and OSDs.

nodes.name: OMEN Tastaturfarben
nodes.author: Kevin
nodes.description: Vier RGB-Zonen mit WASD-Fokus für HP OMEN (Board 8C77). Manuelle Treibereinrichtung erforderlich.

nodes.name: paperless-ngx-inbox
nodes.author: Sebastian & Gemini CLI
nodes.description: Paperless-ngx inbox and document manager in your top bar

nodes.name: Caffeine Curve
nodes.author: Late Compile
nodes.description: Log a coffee with one click, watch it decay in the bar, and see what is still in you at bedtime.

nodes.name: FossFetch
nodes.author: davedes
nodes.description: Search for open-source alternatives to proprietary apps and install them with one click (pacman / AUR / Flatpak).

nodes.name: Mise dotfiles
nodes.author: FilipHarald
nodes.description: Dotfile sync health and watcher controls for mise

nodes.name: IPTV
nodes.author: Sam Blakeman
nodes.description: Single-provider IPTV browser for Omarchy (m3u / Xtream, Live + VOD, XMLTV EPG, favorites, fullscreen TV mode). Themed via shell tokens; playback in external mpv.

nodes.name: Omareel
nodes.author: hadijaveed
nodes.description: Loom-style screen recording for Omarchy: record an area, window, or screen with a webcam bubble and your chosen mic, clean up the audio, upload to R2/S3/B2, and copy a share link. Floating controls while recording plus a bar launcher with in-widget settings.

nodes.name: YouTube Float
nodes.author: jcputney
nodes.description: Pick up where you left off on YouTube, browse subscriptions and search, and play the result in a floating, pinned mpv window.

nodes.name: Owlook
nodes.author: Rafael Peña-Azar
nodes.description: CI, deploy, and queue status for your projects, in the bar.

nodes.name: Mouseless
nodes.author: Bill Kuehler
nodes.description: Keyboard-driven mouse pointer: type a short label to warp the pointer and click, with right, middle, and double click, move-only, and a scroll mode.

nodes.name: VisiGrid Scratch
nodes.author: VisiGrid
nodes.description: A persistent scratch spreadsheet that drops down over your desktop. Replaces the calculator: type numbers and formulas, it remembers them, and the real VisiGrid engine does the math.

nodes.name: FileBlade Agent Hooks
nodes.author: Kurt Buhler
nodes.description: Inventory of configured agent hooks, with commands and secrets redacted, plus an agents strip that copies a hook into another agent's user hook file, for the FileBlade blades.

nodes.name: FileBlade Agent MCP
nodes.author: Kurt Buhler
nodes.description: Configuration-only MCP inventory with cross-agent copies and recoverable removal

nodes.name: OmaQ
nodes.author: hancore
nodes.description: Invite-only 1:1 and group chat for the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Nvag Pulse
nodes.author: Shirak Semonian
nodes.description: Quiet database environment monitor for the Omarchy bar: auto-detects local Docker database containers, polls remote SQL servers with reachability + latency and password-less engine health probes, and only draws attention when something is down.

nodes.name: JotPin
nodes.author: JotPin contributors
nodes.description: A quick Markdown scratchpad for the Omarchy shell.

nodes.name: Text to Speech
nodes.author: hikari
nodes.description: On-demand, local-first speech for selected text and anything visible on screen

nodes.name: Keyboard Layouts
nodes.author: madmatt and contributors
nodes.description: Keyboard layout switcher with variants, a default layout, and switching shortcuts

nodes.name: NTS Radio
nodes.author: Sam Fortin
nodes.description: An unofficial NTS Radio client for Omarchy: live NTS 1 and NTS 2 in the bar, plus a browser window for the archive with search, show and episode pages, tracklists, and a local library of saved shows and episodes. Plays locally through mpv or on a Chromecast.

nodes.name: Hermes Deck
nodes.author: mbot11
nodes.description: Live Hermes Agent companion for Omarchy: status, sessions, usage, kanban, controls, and a drop-down TUI.

nodes.name: Pages
nodes.author: Kvark
nodes.description: Visual editor for pages: see what is running and drag it where it belongs

nodes.name: Omapager
nodes.author: Neil Patel
nodes.description: Notifications for Omarchy: a stacking, grouping replacement for the built-in service, with markup parsing, resolved source icons, inline reply, and per-source snooze.

nodes.name: Look & Feel Studio
nodes.author: Bohar
nodes.description: Interactive visual customization drawer for live window opacity, frosted glass blur, UI scaling, font sizes, and wallpaper rotation.

nodes.name: Omazork
nodes.author: Lucas Bertoni
nodes.description: Zork I/II/III console overlay with casual-mode pacing

nodes.name: Dopamine Text
nodes.author: Alessandro Zambon (z4mbo)
nodes.description: A playful typing counter, eighteen tiny particle effects, and optional gentle sounds.

nodes.name: Grammachy
nodes.author: jyooi
nodes.description: Grammar and spelling checks for any selected text

nodes.name: Skill Manager
nodes.author: Firstpick
nodes.description: Link unchanged local skills across Pi, OpenCode, Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex CLI, with compatibility warnings.

nodes.name: Screen Sharing Indicator
nodes.author: Dennis Thomsen
nodes.description: Presenter-visible red border around the window or monitor currently shared through the desktop portal. The audience sees at most a thin black strip on monitor captures, and nothing at all on window captures.

nodes.name: omathematic-backgrounds
nodes.author: Fernando Moro
nodes.description: An animated mathematical wallpaper that listens to what you play

nodes.name: Onote
nodes.author: lolu13
nodes.description: Sticky notes as tiled Hyprland windows, stored in SQLite, drawn by the shell itself

nodes.name: Bookmark Everything
nodes.author: decadentsavant
nodes.description: Keyboard-first launcher for bookmarked URLs, files, folders, and applications

nodes.name: HSK Mouse
nodes.author: Marc (@keasbee)
nodes.description: Battery, DPI, polling rate and sensor settings for the G-Wolves HSK Pro 4K, in the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Spotlight
nodes.author: Max Randhahn
nodes.description: Unified Spotlight search for apps, windows, files, actions, clipboard, natural-language tools and the web

nodes.name: Quick Bridge
nodes.author: Colin Faulkingham
nodes.description: QR-code bridge to upload from a phone, share a file or clipboard, or proxy a local HTTP port over a Cloudflare quick tunnel.

nodes.name: SSHuttleDeck
nodes.author: jaabell
nodes.description: An SSHuttle SSH VPN tunnel launcher for SSH config aliases, Tailscale machines, and custom endpoints.

nodes.name: hyprpm Manager
nodes.author: TierTek
nodes.description: Hyprland native plugin health in the Omarchy bar. Warns you when hyprpm plugins are about to stop loading, and hands you the one command that fixes it.

nodes.name: Session Restore
nodes.author: David Reed
nodes.description: Save every open window — app, workspace, monitor, size, floating/fullscreen state, and working directory — as a named session. Restore it on demand, or pin one to reopen automatically at login (once per login; a mid-session shell restart will not re-fire it). Optional browser tab capture/restore (off by default) needs python3. Does NOT restore the tiled split arrangement within a workspace — see the README.

nodes.name: Hypertile
nodes.author: Jim Martin
nodes.description: Zone-based tiling layouts for Hyprland's Lua layout API: browse and edit layouts at true scale in a fullscreen overlay, with a bar widget showing the current layout.

nodes.name: Aura Voxtype HUD
nodes.author: Yeshuah Franco
nodes.description: A voice-reactive Omarchy HUD that locally acquires and builds React Bits Strands.

nodes.name: Sony Headphones
nodes.author: Roy Kevin
nodes.description: Sony WH-1000XM5 Headphone Manager

nodes.name: Switchboard
nodes.author: leonaffi-byte
nodes.description: A compact AI usage dashboard with safe Claude account switching and optional automatic switching.

nodes.name: Theme Come True
nodes.author: mapleroyal
nodes.description: Introducing a top bar menu for easily switching between dark/light mode, themes, and wallpapers. Built, optimized, and reviewed by GPT 6 Astra Ultra.

nodes.name: Android Dev
nodes.author: CostaFot
nodes.description: A companion plugin for the typical stuff an Android developer does on the day-to-day: devices, packages, developer toggles, screenshots and recording, APKs, the emulator, scrcpy and wireless debugging.

nodes.name: Token Stats
nodes.author: Erik Burdett
nodes.description: Local LLM tokens per hour in the bar, with an exact-count graph, history, cloud comparison, and Claude Code / Codex agent tracking with a unified resumable sessions list

nodes.name: Omamesh
nodes.author: Josh Clarke
nodes.description: MeshCore companions, nodes, and messages in the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: SimulNetDevice
nodes.author: mattyd-ip
nodes.description: Shows Wi-Fi and Ethernet status at the same time, with saved static IP profiles and primary-interface routing control.

nodes.name: Wallpaper Explorer
nodes.author: EF-Code
nodes.description: Browse and apply wallpapers from any installed Omarchy theme without changing theme colors.

nodes.name: ThemerToggle
nodes.author: l1qu1d
nodes.description: Your favorite light and dark themes, one click apart.

nodes.name: Disk Space
nodes.author: Erik Burdett
nodes.description: A circular disk usage meter with total, used and free space in a popup.

nodes.name: Omarchy Vitals
nodes.author: osesantos
nodes.description: Modular system monitor for the Omarchy bar: one independent entry per metric (CPU, memory, disk, network, sensors), each with its own widget style — text, sparkline, line, bars, pie, fill, or up/down speed — and a click-open detail panel with per-core graphs and top processes.

nodes.name: WM Actions
nodes.author: blafusel
nodes.description: Mouse-only grid of common Hyprland actions plus a current-workspace window switcher

nodes.name: Agent Skills Manager
nodes.author: oliwier-xiao
nodes.description: Every skill, plugin and MCP server your coding agents load, in one list. Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Cursor and Pi each keep theirs in their own folders, and none of them will tell you what the other four are loading — or what it costs you in tokens on every turn. It reads; it does not write to anything an agent loads.

nodes.name: Plex Float
nodes.author: jcputney
nodes.description: Search your Plex library in a native overlay with poster art, and play the pick in a floating, pinned mpv window that follows you across every workspace.

nodes.name: Twitch Float
nodes.author: jcputney
nodes.description: Browse your live Twitch follows, categories and top channels in a native overlay, and play the pick in a floating, pinned mpv window.

nodes.name: PYIN News
nodes.author: chuchua.tech
nodes.description: Get the news. Keep your time. PYIN is a private, finite Omarchy reader with no bot replies, rage bait, popularity contests, or infinite scroll—just reporting you choose, transparent local curation, and optional on-demand AI.

nodes.name: Google Messages
nodes.author: MarcFord
nodes.description: Read and reply to Google Messages from the Omarchy bar

nodes.name: Jenkins Health
nodes.author: H3nr1 D14z

nodes.name: Keystroke
nodes.author: Arseniy Zarechnev
nodes.description: A Raycast-style command palette that replaces the Omarchy menu, with voice, Codex and community extensions

nodes.name: Omarchy Island

nodes.description: Quickbar activity surface for live system state

nodes.name: OmaPen
nodes.author: stempelv

nodes.name: Sportmarchy
nodes.author: exquisiteskink
nodes.description: Follow MLB, MLS, NFL, NBA, and NHL teams from the Omarchy bar. Live scores rotate on the pill; the popup shows next games and opens ESPN.

nodes.name: Print Center
nodes.author: David Reed
nodes.description: Manage CUPS printers and the print queue from your Omarchy bar. A pill shows the default printer's state and queue depth, turning accent or urgent when a printer needs paper, ink, or attention. The popup lists printers with ink levels; cancel, hold, or release jobs; set your default; print a test page; add a driverless network printer. A headless service notifies you when a job finishes, is held, or a printer errors. A Scan tab drives SANE scanners (optional; installs its packages on request).

nodes.name: Familienfabrik.at

nodes.name: Omarchy Extras

nodes.name: Omarchy Help

nodes.description: Offline help for Omarchy, in a window that stays open. Type to search your live keybindings, the omarchy CLI, and the manual for your installed version; results appear as you type with no network and no model. Run a command straight from the results in a floating terminal, open the manual at the matching section, or chat with the local GPU model about what to do.

nodes.name: Herdr Watch

nodes.name: Sports Tracker

nodes.name: Better Workspaces

Middle-click or press R to refresh. If the source is unreachable, the last successful snapshot stays on screen. Settings pick the provider, refresh interval, and how many rates can appear in the bar.

Next Theme puts a contrast circle in your bar: click it for a popup with Previous and Next, or just scroll the icon. Every step applies the real theme to your whole desktop, and the popup stays open and re-colours itself as you browse. It steps in order and never shuffles, so you can walk back to the one you just passed and a single pass shows you every theme exactly once.

nodes.name: OmaTempo

nodes.name: Banatik
nodes.author: banan
nodes.description: Banatik — your MikroTik router in the Omarchy bar. WAN link and public IP, RouterOS version and pending firmware, CPU and memory, Wi-Fi clients with signal, DHCP devices, ZeroTier and WireGuard / Back To Home peers, logins, firewall counters, traffic charts up to 30 days and the router log, read over REST with a read-only user and a pinned certificate. Alerts when the internet link drops, the public IP changes, a new device joins or someone logs into the router.

nodes.name: Video Wallpaper
nodes.author: p3lusa
nodes.description: Desktop wallpaper renderer. Plays the active theme's looping video when that theme ships a videos/ directory, and otherwise behaves exactly like the stock image background (current/background symlink, transitions). Videos pause while the session is locked or idle, and the active clip survives shell restarts.
